# Weekly metrics review: week of 2026-10-19

## Headline

Implied spend rose to $176.8M for the week starting 2026-10-19, a change of +11.2% from the prior week. Total tokens grew faster, at +14.6%.

## What moved and why

Implied spend changed by +$17.8M, from $159.0M in the week starting 2026-10-12 to $176.8M. Volume added +$24.9M. Mix took away -$7.1M. The price effect was +$0.

The price effect is zero because price changes are measured only from 2026-10-28, when daily price snapshots began. It does not show that prices were flat.

Four providers drove the move:

- **Anthropic** added +$16.6M. Volume contributed +$11.1M and mix +$5.5M.
- **Stepfun** subtracted -$11.1M. Volume was +$2.6M, but mix was -$13.7M. Stepfun's mix effect is the main reason the total mix effect was negative.
- **OpenAI** added +$5.8M. Volume contributed +$3.1M and mix +$2.7M.
- **DeepSeek** added +$4.6M. Volume contributed +$1.7M and mix +$2.9M.

The data does not show why mix moved the way it did at any of these providers.

## Providers

Anthropic holds the most spend, at $87.1M, or 49.2% of the total. OpenAI is next at $25.6M (14.5%), then DeepSeek at $15.2M (8.6%).

DeepSeek holds the most paid tokens, with a 39.2% paid-token share. Anthropic and OpenAI each hold 9.6%.

The largest pricing-power gap is Anthropic. Its spend share is 49.2% against a paid-token share of 9.6%, a gap of +39.6 pp. DeepSeek is the reverse, with a gap of -30.7 pp. Z-ai also sits below parity, with a 3.9% spend share against a 12.6% paid-token share.

## What to watch next week

- New-model share of top-50 tokens was 71.6%. Watch whether it holds.
- Four models entered the top 50 this week. Watch whether new entrants keep arriving and how much volume they take.
- DeepSeek tokens moved +30.7% and Google tokens moved -13.3%. Watch whether either continues.

## Data notes

- OpenRouter is one marketplace, not the whole market.
- Implied spend is tokens times list price, with an assumed promp
